manifest.name: v2-ks-linear-dynamic-with-jerk-ff
manifest.description: V1 functional form (KS + understeer + first-order lag + per-segment delta0) plus a small steering-rate feedforward term (c_dot * d_delta/dt * v) added to the steady-state yaw rate. Tesla falls through to V0 passthrough (no truth channel).
manifest.notes: V1 sits at the structural ceiling for this functional form on the dev set. Per-platform parameter refits, second-order lag, and a soft-weighted delta0 estimator all gave <1% yaw improvement (or made CTE worse). The dominant CTE driver is per-segment delta0 mis-estimation on Mustang and Hyundai, which is not addressable without truth-channel access at predict time.
